ValidationRule.description: Rule works with the the Relationship Owner Field & Flow to make sure there is only one Relationship Owner on the team to get integrated with Hubspot.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISPICKVAL( TeamMemberRole__c , 'Contact Owner') && NOT(ISBLANK( ContactId__r.Relationship_Owner__c )) && NOT (ISCHANGED(UserId__c ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: There is currently a Relationship Owner on this Contact. Please change the User in the current record or delete the current record to make Relationship Owner Adjustments.
